name: Muramite Citadel: Command
summary: The strategic command center of the Muramite Legion, where warfront operations are planned and directed.
description: The Command Center is the most secure non‑arcane chamber in the Citadel Interior. Muramite commanders oversee troop deployments, warfront strategy, prisoner processing, and Discord energy allocation. Massive stone tables, Discord‑etched maps, and fortified planning alcoves dominate the chamber. Inquisitors maintain ritual wards to protect the command hierarchy, while elite guards patrol every corridor. Dragorn infiltrators rarely survive entry, as the Command Center is the beating heart of Muramite military power.
